_comment: Mon-Sat. 10 one-hour period slots 08:00-18:00 as in last year's aSc file. Periods 5 and 6 (12:00-14:00) are the LUNCH BREAK - circular 51/2018 I.3 requires a two-hour separation between the morning and evening sessions. That leaves 4 morning + 4 evening teaching periods, which matches the circular's 'max 4 hours for a pupil in one session'.
